note.p: See Ed Pope's notes: Goodwin 29.4.1800 at Foulkes's / 26.1.1812 at Collier's / 8.10.1814 J Goodwin calls Work notes Law List 1800 Harvey Goodwin attorney of King's Lynn will PCC 1819, George Goodwin of King's Lynn Poems 1798 dedicated to Richard Howard (1733 -1818 bro of Lord Bagot) of Ashtead Hall, Surrey perhaps same as Geo G adm Inner Temple 1804 father of Rev George Harvey Goodwin Alum Ox 1802-1838 / Law List 1800 John and Richard Goodwin attorneys of Ashbourne Derbys Richard's will PCC 1814 / Thomas Goodwyn lawyer of Greenwich Kent PCC 1826 not found in Inns of Court / Rev Samuel Charles Goodwin DCL Alum Ox 1762-1835 died Paris / Henry Goodwyn 1796 Brewer's assistant (tables) 15.12.1800 East Smithfield tables of Interest publ in Wm Nicholson's Journal Jan 1801 vol 4 p433, will PCC 1805, 1824, Henry Goodwin 1809 Henry Goodwyn and Co brewers 21 Lower East Smithfield 1781-1791 / Thomas Goodwyn 1804 Hampstead waters MRCSurgeons / Dr Edmund Goodwyn DNB 1756-1829 will PCC 1829 book on respiration publ by Joseph Johnson 1788 / Dr Anthony Goodwin will PCC 1819 Derbyshire / Edward Goodwin will PCC 1816 bookseller and stationer St Geo Han Sq / J Goodwin Brook St, Holborn printer imprint 1807 perhaps Jonas Goodwin appr Stationers Coy 1785
